verdict.rationale: New Relic's docs say you can instrument services with OpenTelemetry and integrate OpenTelemetry data with the platform for analysis, so OTel support is a documented first-party feature. But nothing in the pack says telemetry can be sent directly over the OTLP protocol, and the depth of the support is not shown. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a native OTLP ingest endpoint, details on which signals (traces/metrics/logs) are supported over OTLP, independent or hands-on corroboration.
